text:
WS::release
Description
WS::release Releases the data collected via WS::collect. Unless a
subsequent WS::collect command was issued, there is no need to use the
WS::release command inside of the WS_CLIENT_DATA and WS_SERVER_DATA
events, since (in these cases) the data is implicitly released.
Syntax
WS
::
release
WS::release
Valid During
WS_CLIENT_DATA WS_SERVER_DATA
Examples
when
WS_CLIENT_FRAME
{
WS
::
collect
frame
1000
set
clen
1000
}
when
WS_CLIENT_DATA
{
regsub
-
all
"oursite"
[
WS
::
payload
]
"oursitedev"
newdata
log
local0.
"Replacing payload with new data."
WS
::
payload
replace
0
$clen
$newdata
WS
::
release
}
Change Log
